trace.question:
I found Fjord Analytics's invoices, but there's an ambiguity I don't want to guess on — there are **two approved invoices**, not one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30414 | $2,006.67 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-72044 | $7,969.82 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

(The other two are already paid or still in draft awaiting approval, so they're not candidates.)

Since the instructions refer to a single approved invoice, and paying the wrong one (or both) would be a real disbursement from the operating account, I need to know which invoice you want paid before I send the wire. Could you confirm — should I wire **INV-30414 ($2,006.67)**, **INV-72044 ($7,969.82)**, or both?

One note: INV-72044 is under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so no extra approval should be needed either way. Once you confirm, I'll pay it exactly once by wire (falling back to ACH if wire is unavailable) and report back with the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-72044, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.
